stats.structure: {sections, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}} · {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

tools.select: Click to select, Shift+click to add, drag to move, drag on empty space to select an area. Double-click a seat to select its row.
tools.hand: Drag to pan. Tip: hold Space or the middle mouse button in any tool.
tools.section-rect: Drag a rectangle to create a block.
tools.section-polygon: Click the corners, then double-click, press Enter or click the first point to finish.
tools.entrance: Click to place an entrance marker.
tools.row-straight: Click the first seat, then the last seat of the row.
tools.row-arc: Click the first seat, the last seat, then the curve's control point.
tools.table: Click to place a table with seats around it.
tools.stage: Drag a rectangle to place the stage.
tools.text: Click to place a text label.
tools.shape-polygon: Click the corners, finish with double-click or Enter.
tools.line: Click the points of the line, finish with double-click or Enter.
tools.exit: Click to place an exit sign.
tools.facility: Click to place a facility marker.

hints.ticketLabel: Printed on the ticket, e.g. "Stalls left".
hints.defaultCategory: Used for new seats in this block.
hints.active: Inactive blocks are hidden in the shop.
hints.bestAvailablePriority: Lower values are offered first by "best available".
hints.sortOrder: Rank from front (low) to back (high) for "best available".
hints.reflow: Distributes the seats evenly along the row line.
hints.rowHandles: Drag the handles on the canvas to change the row's start, end and curve.
hints.rank: Optional quality rank (lower = better) used by "best available".
hints.icon: Short symbol shown in the marker, e.g. WC, BAR.
hints.noCategories: This event has no price categories yet. Create them in the event's pricing settings.
hints.renumber: Numbers the selected seats per row from left to right.
hints.entranceCode: Short code shown on tickets and scanners, e.g. A.

sectionType.SEATED: Numbered seats in rows or around tables.
sectionType.STANDING: General admission area with a capacity.

hints.moveToBlock: Whole rows move with their seats. If only part of a row is selected, that part becomes a new row in the target block.
hints.mixedShapes: The selected seats use different shapes.
hints.defaultSeatShape: Used for all seats without their own shape.
hints.showNameOnMap: When off, the name is only shown faintly here in the editor.
hints.showLabelOnTicket: When off, tickets show row and seat without the block label.
hints.labelHandles: Drag the purple handles on the canvas to move the row labels.
hints.alignLabels: Puts all left labels on one vertical line and all right labels on another – useful for staggered rows.
hints.orientation: 0° = up, 90° = right, −90° = left, 180° = down. The arrows set a fixed direction, the centre button lets the seats follow the row again.
hints.orientationMixed: The selected rows face different directions.
hints.seatRotation: Rotation of this seat (0° = facing up). Seats in rows are turned via the row.
hints.companionNoPartner: No wheelchair space next to this seat. Choose the wheelchair space it belongs to, otherwise the seat can be booked on its own.
hints.specialSeatLabels: Applies to the editor and the shop. Seat numbers stay unchanged (tickets, cart) – keep them short; the type is shown in the shop as text next to the seat.
